notes: Covid year: a smaller field of 16 teams in four 4-team pools (A-Red, B-Blue, C-Yellow, D-Green), 3 rounds of 2 games each.
Top 3 from each pool made a 12-team bracket; the four winless teams did not advance.
Red, Blue and Yellow games are reconstructed from the round tables; every team's point total matches the figure written beside its name.
Green's round 3 is covered by tape in the photo, so that pool is entered as records only (Teams tab Record column) with no game scores.
Seed Overrides pin each pool's top 3 as seeded into the bracket.
The 2020 final was not written on the bracket at the time; the result — Trash n Stache over Muck Fichigan — was confirmed later from memory.
ticker: WELCOME TO THE 2020 B.B.G.C. — The covid year. Four groups, four teams per group. Three from each group advance to the knockout round.

GROUP PLAY · RED — The defending champions arrived and made a statement. Hawkeyes 3-0, 58 points, untouched. The Seekers took second at 2-1, and I Can't Decide slipped in at 1-2 ahead of winless Guns n Rollers. HAWKEYES, THE SEEKERS and I CAN'T DECIDE advance.

GROUP PLAY · BLUE — Muck Fichigan matched them stride for stride: 3-0 and 61 points, the best mark of the day. Vivace do Tinge went 2-1, Spencer Torkelson 1-2. Balz Deep went home without a win. MUCK FICHIGAN, VIVACE DO TINGE and SPENCER TORKELSON advance.

GROUP PLAY · YELLOW — Nobody could separate. Del Bocce Vista, Trash n Stache and Dickens Cider ALL finished 2-1, and it came down to points: 58, 56, 43. Three teams in, D-Boccery out at 0-3. DEL BOCCE VISTA, TRASH N STACHE and DICKENS CIDER advance.

GROUP PLAY · GREEN — Covid Cowboys came through the only group nobody could beat outright, finishing 2-0-1. Vandelay Industries Industries 2-1, Brothers Boor 1-1-1, and The Boys r Back never got going. COVID COWBOYS, VANDELAY INDUSTRIES INDUSTRIES and BROTHERS BOOR advance.

ROUND ONE — Dickens Cider ousted The Seekers. Del Bocce Vista saw off Spencer Torkelson. Vandelay Industries Industries ended I Can't Decide. And Trash n Stache put out Brothers Boor. Four gone, eight left, and the giants were waiting.

QUARTERFINALS — And the giants fell. Muck Fichigan held serve over Dickens Cider, but Del Bocce Vista upset Vivace do Tinge, Trash n Stache ran through the unbeaten Covid Cowboys, and then the big one: VANDELAY INDUSTRIES INDUSTRIES KNOCKED OUT THE HAWKEYES. The defending champions, 3-0 in the group, out in one game.

SEMIFINALS — Muck Fichigan turned back Del Bocce Vista to reach the final unbeaten. And Trash n Stache, who'd already taken down the Covid Cowboys, did it again — ending Vandelay Industries Industries's giant-killing run. Two teams left.

THE FINAL — Muck Fichigan: 3-0, 61 points, group champions, two clean bracket wins, not a blemish anywhere. Trash n Stache: out of the three-way logjam in Yellow, and then the hardest road in the tournament — the undefeated Covid Cowboys AND the team that put out the champions.

🏆 CHAMPIONS: TRASH N STACHE 🏆 — Out of a three-way logjam in Yellow, past the unbeaten Covid Cowboys, past the side that had just knocked out the defending champions, and then past Muck Fichigan — 3-0 in their group and unbeaten all day — with the trophy on the line. And a word for Spencer: the drunkest man ever to win this tournament. The covid year belongs to Trash n Stache.
